scale.label: 51 µm
scale.meaning: Critical Turing wavelength of the Schnakenberg pair on a larval sensory-vesicle-sized patch. The tier label is 51 µm; the SI pin used by the solver is 5.056e-05 m = 50.56 µm.

age.what_changes_at_this_scale: Nothing in the species name changes at 0 Ma (the series has one member). Relative to a finer melanosome scale (~1 µm) the 51 µm mode does not fit inside one granule. Relative to the adult body on the 10 mm scale bar (~34 mm in YPM IZ 082346) the same mode is repeated many times and is not resolved as a separate stripe. The quantity that is special to this slot is k_c, not a chronospecies boundary.

equations.kinetics: du/dt = Du lap u + gamma (a - u + u^2 v); dv/dt = Dv lap v + gamma (b - u^2 v)
equations.wavenumber: k_c^2 = gamma (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.boundary_condition: periodic on a square patch of side 4 * lambda_c

state_variables.u: activator (pigment-promoting field); not identified with a named Ciona transcript

empirical_claims: Turing (1952) gives the dispersion relation whose critical wavenumber is implemented here.
Schnakenberg (1979) supplies the two-species kinetics. The parameter numbers are chosen so lambda_c equals the slot pin; they are not a fit to a Ciona dose-response curve.
Ciona pigment cells have a neural-crest-like origin (Abitua et al. 2012). A related urochordate makes body pigment with migratory neural-crest-like cells (Jeffery et al. 2004).
The larval brain contains an ocellus and an otolith in the sensory vesicle (Hudson 2016; Kourakis et al. 2021). Hotta et al. (2007) stage the embryo through the hatching larva.
Brunetti et al. (2015) separate Ciona robusta (type A) from Ciona intestinalis (type B). The Peabody specimen is catalogued as Ciona intestinalis.
The adult photograph's pigment spacing, measured with its 10 mm bar, is not the 51 µm pin. That mismatch is a scale-transfer result, not a failure of k_c inside the detail patch.
negative_controls: Equal diffusion Du = Dv: cross term is negative and the critical mode decays.
gamma = 0: pure diffusion, the seeded cosine decays.
Adult speckle spacing versus the 51 µm pin: different scales.
